Subject: Guest access rotation + API escrow plan for Elara Health

Hi Sarah — great to meet you on the call this morning. As promised, I wanted to put an initial plan in writing for how we recommend handling first-mile workspace access, API key seeding, and a short-term "escrow" rotation so your ops team can validate integrations without permanent long-lived keys.

High-level proposal (next 10 business days):
- Week 0 (today -> 3 business days): create one admin workspace and seed two service accounts (one for staging, one for prod-preview).
- Week 1: invite 3 Elara engineering users (owner, infra, app lead) with scoped roles. Rotate staging key after integration smoke tests.
- Week 2: hand over production service account to Elara with HSM-backed KMS guidance and scheduled rotation policy.

Key asks from Elara today:
- Confirm preferred identity for invites ( corporate emails vs. shared group )
- Confirm whether you want ephemeral service accounts (we provide rotation scripts) or full service-account handover on day 10

I've attached a proposed onboarding access matrix and a short note titled api-escrow-rotation.md that outlines the rotation schedule and commands. If that looks good I'll schedule a 30-min technical walk-through with Jonas and our infra lead.

Attachments: elara_onboarding_access_matrix.xlsx (roles + invite cadence), api-escrow-rotation.md, seed-commands.sh

Thanks —
Priyom Das

Thanks — putting the configuration details below so everyone has the same page for Thursday's tech walk-through. I attached a detailed access matrix (elara_onboarding_access_matrix.xlsx).

Proposed access matrix (summary):
- Organization admin: 1 Elara user (Sarah) + 1 Redwood CS admin (Monica) — full view, billing hidden.
- Project-level roles: App-Developer (invite 2), Infra (invite 1), Read-only Observability (invite 2).
- Service accounts:
  - SA-staging: scoped to project:generate + embeddings, seed key expires in 7 days (escrowed).
  - SA-prod-preview: scoped to project:generate + long-context, seed key expires in 30 days (rotation recommended).

API escrow rotation plan (see api-escrow-rotation.md):
- Rotation schedule options: 7-day (staging), 30-day (preview), 90-day (prod after handoff).
- Scripts: seed-commands.sh will create ephemeral keys and push a rotated key to a secret manager of your choice (we demonstrate AWS Secrets Manager & GCP Secret Manager).
- Audit: we enable token-level logging for any onboarding keys and provide a one-week retention export for your security team.

Thursday 9:00am PT works for me — I sent a calendar invite to the three Elara addresses and to Jonas and David. We'll cover: invite cadence, seeding commands, rotation demo, and a handoff checklist.

Attachments: elara_onboarding_access_matrix.xlsx, api-escrow-rotation.md, seed-commands.sh

Quick technical runbook we'll use on Thursday (condensed):
1) Create workspace: run seed-commands.sh --org elara-health --env staging --sa-name SA-staging
   - Example: ./seed-commands.sh create-sa --name SA-staging --scopes generate,embeddings --ttl 7d
2) Invite users: ./seed-commands.sh invite --email sarah.lane@elarahealth.com --role org_admin
3) Rotate key (demo): ./seed-commands.sh rotate-key --sa SA-staging --push-to secretsmanager://elara-staging/rr1
4) Promote preview -> prod: document handoff in shared Drive folder and create a final audit export.

Notes for Friday SOW/Procurement: Priyom — Monica — please include the 30-day trial discount that Elara requested and call out that seeded onboarding keys are temporary and will be rotated prior to production handover.
